text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and the others appeared in the "Fastest Finger Quiz"
segment at a fan appreciation event hosted by the URA.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay~~♪
Falco got it right once again, huh☆
Smart Falcon tried her best to answer the quiz questions, but—
Mihono Bourbon shows no sign of pressing the button, and Agnes Tachyon seems completely spaced out. Because of that, the venue atmosphere is rather subdued...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm... All right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Falco might just be too strong♪
...Though at this rate, there's not much of a challenge~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I know! How about letting the fans come up with the questions from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And anyone other than 1st place gets a... penalty gaaame☆
Then, with a collective roar of awe, the venue erupted into applause in support of the proposal!
Smart Falcon intends to draw in the entire venue and fire up the crowd with everything she's got.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For the penalty game, hmm, let's see~
How about the two losers have to drink a concoction made by Tachyon-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? You wish to try my prototype drink? Fufufu, this is the perfect opportunity for an experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'd be delighted to provide it!
And by all means, you two must drink it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, Tachyon-chan is in serious mode!
Bourbon-chan, you gotta do your best too!
Or you'll end up with a penalty game!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If I touch the buzzer button, I will likely break the machine.
Are you certain that is acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Is that why you couldn't answer?!
Well then, from now on, raise your hands instead!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, correct once again. Wouldn't it be wise to brace yourself mentally?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san's win rate is rising.
I will release my limiter as well.
Boost mode ON: fastest hand raise.

Thanks to the rules proposed by Smart Falcon, the two are in full serious mode.
Because of that, the spectator seats are overflowing with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What should I do~~!
The two of them going all out are way too strong~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wants to win together with everyone!
So... help me out with the quiz, okay?☆"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooo--! Falco-chaaan!
Leave it to uuuus~~!!
Agnes Tachyon with her wealth of knowledge. Mihono Bourbon raising her hand in a tenth of a second. Smart Falcon winning over the fans.

The fans were going wild over the back-and-forth battle
showcasing each of their unique strengths! And then—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's massive victory~~♪
Now then, you two, dig in☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's run this experiment countless times.
There's hardly any thrill in drinking it myself now, is there?
Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Emergency! Emergency!
A critical system error has occurred...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
All circuits cut. System down...
It will take some time for my sense of taste to reboot...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks so gross~~!
You gave it your best, Bourbon-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Tachyon-chan, you can do itâª
Make sure to drink it all upâ

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! Tachyon-chan and
Bourbon-chan's reactions are insanely rare!
I-I'm so, so glad to be aliveee!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Great reactions from both of you♪
The event was a huge success~~, huh☆

And so, the Quick-Buzzer Quiz Tournament
drew to a close with tremendous success!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, great work♪
It turned into such a fun event~
choice_data_list: There was a moment I wasn't sure how things would turn out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪ I think the two of them
just weren't quite sure what they were supposed to do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco and all the fans already knew the two of you could shine on stageâª
Falco just gave you the spark to start!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was a success because the entire venue joined forces.
That's the absolute most fun part of being on stage☆
choice_data_list: I had a great time too!
You really gave it your all!
You really gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was a success because the entire venue joined forces.
That's the absolute most fun part of being on stage☆
choice_data_list: I had a great time too!
You really gave it your all!
You really gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu, when it comes to the stage, leave it to Falco! ...Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I should have made my move earlier?
Yeah, time for a review session once I get back!"
Smart Falcon looked so dependable as she thought about her fans with such stoic dedication!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks♪ But it's not over yet.
I've gotta give the fans even more service!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking photos for Umastagram♪
Where could Bourbon-chan and Tachyon-chan be~~?

Her determination to entertain the fans until the very end
showed her true pride as an Umadol!
